g.id: Revenue growth: year 1, years 2 to 5, then glide to terminal growth
Operating margin converging to the target by the convergence year
Tax: effective rate for years 1 to 5, fading to the marginal rate; NOL shield
Reinvestment = change in revenue divided by sales-to-capital (one-year lag)
Free cash flow to the firm = EBIT after tax minus reinvestment
Cost of equity = rf + levered beta x (mature ERP + country risk premium)
Industry unlevered beta, re-levered for the company's debt (India fallback at 10 firms)
Synthetic rating and default spread (+ country spread)
Cost of capital path (WACC), gliding to rf + mature ERP in the terminal year
Present value of 10 years of FCFF
Terminal value = FCFF in year 11 / (terminal WACC minus g); g = rf; stable ROIC = WACC
Value of operating assets, adjusted for failure probability and recovery
Equity = operating assets minus debt minus minority interests plus cash plus non-operating assets minus options
